author: Drew Woods
review: Alright Google, it's a solid app. But here's the deal, we've become accustomed to this behaviour where my photos are backed up. Now that this will take up my limited amount of free space, I'm FORCED to pay OR not use the service. Well I'm not paying. Plain and simple. I have my own personal cloud storage device. I just happen to like your UI a bit better. Plus the AI is better. BUT, I pay for Amazon Prime. They offer free storage for my photos now. Sooooo, you're really losing access to ALL of my new photos, and not gaining anything from me. I'd highly recommend you reconsider this decision. In the very least, allow for a CERTAIN amount of space BEFORE it adds on to your storage. Like, allow 100 free full size photos a month. That's 3 photos a day roughly. That's fair. And wouldn't take up TOO much space. I'd be a bit more conscious about what I'm backing up and whatnot, but that's fine. I tend to just take a bunch of burst shots and save them all but I only really need the best one. Anyway, that's all. You are now just an archive of old photos. Unless there is a free storage option, I won't be uploading any photos to this. Thank you.

review: My Pixel 6 suddenly restarted out of nowhere and Google Photos started to duplicate all my photos and theeen it started to backup the duplicates !!! metadata.replyText: Hi Mkrtchyan. When you create an album on Google Photos, a copy of the file is created, but it will not consume storage. If you delete the photo from the album, it will remain in your Google Photos account. If the photo is deleted, it will be deleted everywhere. Also, take a look at this article: goo.gle/37eSSXM to fix problem with the app. Thanks.

review: Great app! Best place to store photos since Photobucket! The only cruddy part is if your account gets hacked, they have access to your old photos & videos. Also, since I forgot my password on a few accounts & don't have the same numbers anymore, I lost a lot of memories.): I wouldn't mind, but the pictures of my babies... Gone forever. I don't see how with all this ai technology, they can't just compare your photos and info to help you regain access. I make a new account with every new phone...

metadata.replyText: That doesn't sound good, Miranda. You can try resetting your password by completing the steps on this page: g.co/help/me623. These tips may help: g.co/help/gqq63. Thanks.

author: Michael Worcel
review: I hate this app. I can never find a photo Im' looking for unless I scroll through multiple categories. Why can't everything be in one place so you don't have to search through the "library" of categories. It automatically places them in a certain spot without giving you a choice. AWFUL. I get so frustrated when I want to pull up a photo on my phone to show someone and them it takes me 5 minutes to find it.

author: Tony Johnson
review: Not sure why so many people say the app makes you pay you to print your own photos... You don't get charged If you use your own printer and ink... Duh. The app works fine for what you need it for. It Stores and organizes media, you can search for photos with keywords, you can make minor tweaks and edits, but don't expect to be able to get Photoshop features out of it.

author: Mis Jane
review: I really like Google Photos, but I wish there was a way to view or recover my pictures based on the original folders they were saved in on my phone. Right now, all the photos are mixed together, and it’s hard to find things if I had them organized into folders before. Please add an option to keep or view photos by folder – it would make things so much easier for organizing and finding old pictures! thank you!

author: Thomas Janousek
review: Terrible app. There is no mass camera roll, instead the default storage of photos is by date, which just looks and feels more unorganized. Counterintuitive I know, but it's true. Photos taken in airplane mode just default to a random date, meaning you can't find them very easily when you want to see them, and obviously they aren't in the correct chronology of when you took them. Automatically creates random photo folders without adding those photos to your camera roll. 1 star do not recommend.

author: A Google user
review: Another Gallery app that spoon-feeds photo organization by what THEY want - by date. Give me a gallery that simply displays my photos the way I have organized them - in directories, IN ALPHABETICAL ORDER, nothing more !! Google programmers can't seem to be able to do a simple array. What I see is a random list of directories, not based on any alphabet known to man, making it impossible to find a photo. Your AI search is useless in searching for abstracted photos, etc.

author: Lyu-Shan Wellmann
review: Since the last update photos taken with the Phone camera will show normally for about a second, then automatically boost the light sources in the picture. I could not find a way to turn this "feature" off. While some photos might look better with the "enhancement", the big issue is that the photos you see in the photos app will be very different than the same photos you share on another app. Please give users a way to disable this nonsense, or turn it into a tool in the image editor.

metadata.replyText: Hi there. We value your feedback. Feel free to share feedback with us here: https://goo.gl/FR5ib2. Thanks.

author: Kelly Miller
review: Google photos is great. The reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because of some of the smaller things I found, but overall I love it. The fact that you can search keywords, or faces, or landmarks makes it really convenient when trying to look for a specific photo. The only downside (and reason for the 4 stars) is because sometimes it can get really picky and not find something that's obviously in the photo. But I typically will think of another keyword for it. I highly do recommend using!

author: Rebekah Anderson
review: I really dislike the most recent update. sorting things into "collections" I feel like I can't find my photos. literally, I'll take a screenshot, then look at the "screenshot" collection and it's not there. I can't find photos I had no problem finding before. it needs to be changed back. ------------:----I got a response to this saying collections help find things easier. they do not. The photos I used to find quickly, I have to dig just to find.

metadata.replyText: Hi Rebekah. The Collections view is the new destination where you can find photos, videos, and Google Photos features more quickly and easily. The Collections view replaces the Library tab. Learn more: goo.gle/46IVLQA. Also, feel free to share feedback with us here: goo.gle/3gaHLEz.

author: Tony Ricketts
review: I have really liked the app, so far! The auto-animations, collages, and filters are generally pretty good. And honestly, I wouldn't end up making them myself... So for Google to make them for me is great. Collecting images by face is great, too. Even for pets! I just wish I was better at getting old photos included in the app so it could go through those as well.

author: A Google user
review: Love, love, love this app! So many great features! You can easily group photos together by people, places, things, selfies, etc. Makes it so much easier to find that photo that you're looking for. And you can even make a photo book! I plan on using this in the very near future with Mother's Day and Father's Day coming up. It doesn't have to be a commercial holiday to make one. It's great for scrapbooking, organizing your photos, and various edits.

author: A Google user
review: Few feedback . If I search for an album, currently only those uploaded by me are shown and not those shared with me in search results. . A time delay option should be made available before the uploads starts. You see I am. Not a pro photographer, I do make mistakes and I would like to delete those mistakes before it gets uploaded. The delay will allow me to delete/edit photos before it gets uploaded. . The album search is not always handy. It shows photos but many albums which I know are there are not shown. I have to manually scroll through all of. The albums to get it. . The most irritating part, if I share a pic with someone,the app should just give me a link to share which it does but it also for some strange reasons creates a new album with that photo. This eventually ends up clogging my album gallery. You can just give a link using which people can view / download.

author: A Google user
review: Very good and fast. Duplicate checking is incredible. But Flickr has more organizing features. 1)We have option to sort photos or videos in an Album but Please add option to sort Albums by name or any order that we can customize. 2)Please give us an option to search for photos that were never not added to an Album.3)Please add option to show the number of Photos and Videos in the Album like Flickr, right it just shows the total combined. 4)Please give us a "Where used"option for each photo/video, so that we know which Album it is used

author: A Google user
review: Honestly, I'm impressed with the app. The main reason I downloaded it was for the backup and flexibility of that feature. The stylized photos the app creates are amazing. And the panoramas I've had created form 7 photos are flawless. You cannot tell that it's not one photo. Impressive! As far as printing an image is concerned, I imagine if you can share to a printer, it should work. Aside from that, I could not find a print function, but I do not have a printer driver & printer installed.

author: A Google user
review: very upset. I doubt you will read my review, but I had freed up some space from my gallery thinking ALL of my photos would be moved to my Google photos. I was very upset to discover that many of my pictures of my new born son were deleted. I could not find the photos. These photos are irreplaceable and I'm afraid I will never get them back. If there is a way you can help me recover them I we re-rate the app.

author: Scott Mcluer
review: Google app hides and makes critical pictures disappear and decides how to arrange them so you can't find them. The best part is selling your jobsite photos back to you and have cute albums and portraits of plumbing and stupid junk. I have so many reminders to update and buy my own property than i can ever find my picture when i would like to see it.

author: A Google user
review: I love how Google photos organizes your photos. You can tell it to recognize a face as someone and then next time you type that person's name in the search bar it pulls up all the photos. It also works to put a word or two in a photos info then next time you can search that word(s) to pull up that photo. It also makes really good suggestions, like archiving old photos. And it makes sharing photos SO easy. It even allows people to make comments on the album/photos. 10/10 would recommend!

author: Leanna J
review: Extremely frustrating! Backing up photos is a joke. It can't find half my folders on my phone and then mixes all the folders all together. There's no daily or weekly backup options - I don't need every single screenshot backed up, but as soon as I take it, it gets backed up in Google before I get a chance to send and then delete it from my device. All to be told my storage has run out, buy more now! It's a great way to push people into paying for services they don't actually need. Great job 👏

author: A Google user
review: Non user-friendly. Too much unnecessary stuff. But doesn't allow for the most obvious functions like "arrange by date", at least you have to purposely look for it (I still couldn't find). Photos are a total mess and I can't find a way to sort them. Rather have no fancy nonsense, but just a simple library by date where I can scroll and find the pictures taken.

author: A Google user
review: The options are out of this world. You can set your camera to infinite gradations of raw, JPG, HRD+ etc settings. The app actually teaches even seasoned photographers more finely honed skills all the time. And it still allows you to revert to purely manual control. I wish I had this years ago, when I developed an interest in photography when my kids were little. You look at old photos from negatives and you cry. The dark sky option is an unbelievable bonus.

author: Rachael Slade
review: The new update is terrible. I can't find any of my photos. For example, if I used to look up the word restaurant, it would show me all the photos of restaurants that I took along with any screenshots or paperwork with the word restaurant. I have purposely photos with words next to them so I could find them fast and the future. Now it's no longer works. I search for a very specific word and no longer do my items come up with that word. Comes up with a whole bunch of other stuff.

metadata.replyText: Thank you for letting us know, Rachael. Please update the app to the latest version. If you're still having issues, send us in app feedback, adding '#search': https://goo.gle/3gaHLEz.

author: A Google user
review: Good app. Wish i could post selections from albums to facebook, though, instead of having to scroll down individuals photos to find what i want. Also, would love to be able to add a note or name or label to each photo & also be able to search for it with that label when posting to other sites like Facebook. Also to just be able to search for photos that way when i am in the Photos app.

author: Drew Woods
review: Alright Google, it's a solid app. But here's the deal, we've become accustomed to this behaviour where my photos are backed up. Now that this will take up my limited amount of free space, I'm FORCED to pay OR not use the service. Well I'm not paying. Plain and simple. I have my own personal cloud storage device. I just happen to like your UI a bit better. Plus the AI is better. BUT, I pay for Amazon Prime. They offer free storage for my photos now. Sooooo, you're really losing access to ALL of my new photos, and not gaining anything from me. I'd highly recommend you reconsider this decision. In the very least, allow for a CERTAIN amount of space BEFORE it adds on to your storage. Like, allow 100 free full size photos a month. That's 3 photos a day roughly. That's fair. And wouldn't take up TOO much space. I'd be a bit more conscious about what I'm backing up and whatnot, but that's fine. I tend to just take a bunch of burst shots and save them all but I only really need the best one. Anyway, that's all. You are now just an archive of old photos. Unless there is a free storage option, I won't be uploading any photos to this. Thank you.

author: Laura Cobb
review: "If it ain't broke, don't fix it." I do not like the new updates at all, they have made the app more difficult to use and find things. It was great before and they should have left it alone. They took away the "sharing" link and now I can't find photos and videos my son has shared. They also took away the link (I think it may have been labeled "for you"?) that took you to all of the collages, animated pictures, movies that Google made from your photos.

author: A Google user
review: I love it because one, it automatically backs up my photos, and as someone who has lost photos before because of a device breaking down or corrupting, this means the world to me. Then two, I love being able to search for specific things whether it be people, pets, objects, or other things. It's saved me so much headaches I could've had like when searching for things I need as reference for something at work because it recognizes practically anything in a picture.

author: Andy Leone
review: This app was so easy to use and create sharble abums. Now ever since updates it is not as user friendly and the MOST important thing is some of the album's have missing pictures. The other problem is if pictures are added to an album by others, even though you save them. If that person deletes them or changes phone numbers or email the pictures disappeared Even when you hit the save to library button. VERY unreliable. I am a paying Google customer and I tried to call tech support. NO HELP

author: A Google user
review: Not at all what I thought it was. I downloaded this after Google image search stopped letting me save directly off of the search, thinking Photos would solve that issue. That's not the case here. My phone's gallery app works just fine. I don't need Google to be a data cloud, fully knowing that my images are being used for other data-gathering purposes. There are better clouds for that. No thank you.

author: Pete
review: Automatically moves photos to albums, then can't find them. Ridiculous. Google is dropping the ball in the software development dept, launching before suitable testing in multiple areas. This is one of them. Edit: 10/20/20 - worse than ever. STOP MOVING MY PHOTOS TO A FOLDER/WHEREVER YOU THINK THEY SHOULD FIT. THANKS MY JOB, NOT YOURS.

author: Tamara Kane
review: Update Jan 21, 2025: Increasing my rating as Google listened and added a pet face feature! Still want to tag my cat in more pics, but it's getting better. They also made it easier to rename or at least describe photos and that's important for search. I still don't like the "feature" where you only have 1 copy of a pic. For an artist, I need to have slightly different versions of the same photo in multiple places and delete from a folder, but not all devices. Bad:Timestamps can cause lost photos.

author: Robbie Bloom
review: Downloading this app was a necessary evil at the time. And while G made it easy to get my photos to the app, It's very difficult to get them back to my phone in bulk. I sent G an email letting them know and asking for help but no one ever responded. Other complaints... Pictures that were in folders on my phone are now scattered throughout the app by date. Also... a bigger problem... MISSING PICTURES! I ordered a laptop with a huge memory so I don't have to deal with this anymore!

metadata.replyText: Hi Robbie! Try following the steps in this article to find your photos: goo.gle/362y6wg. If these didn't resolve your issues, can you please post your question in our Help Forum so product experts can work with you to resolve this issue: goo.gle/3o5JIVl? We hope we helped.

author: A Google user
review: I am highly upset and disappointed, I've been using Google backup for yeeeearrrssssss now and I've never had a problem, but I guess as I see other commenters saying ever since ya'll updated the app. I'm missing photos, videos and albums this is CRAZY!!! I have alot of precious memories and things that I can't get back!!! I don't know what you did, but ya'll really need to fix this or I see a lawsuit coming!!!! I trusted Google backup, never had a problem now this....

author: A Google user
review: My main issue is that I'm constantly trying to find my photos after editing them. There is a feature that groups original photos with the edited ones, together in one "file"...which results in me having to scroll forever to get to the original to find the newly edited one. This is such a departure from how my gallery used to be, before Google Photos, which I really miss.

author: Amogh Simha
review: The issues below seem to have been resolved. Bumping my review up to 3 stars. Preserving my comments below in case some poor soul has the same issues and comes across it. Know that your pain was shared, lonely soldier... I can't see my old photos anymore. My uploads are not going through, I'm not able to add photos to albums. My videos keep buffering. They just won't play! I have ~7 years worth of photos and videos backed up here. I can't even pack up and move to a different app.

metadata.replyText: Oh no, Amogh! We're sorry to hear you're having trouble. We suggest that you take a look at this article: goo.gle/37eSSXM to fix problems with the app. If the problem persists, we ask that you post a topic in the Google Photos Help Forum to get help from our experts: goo.gle/3o5JIVl. We hope we helped.

author: A Google user
review: Overall a messy app. Hard to organize pictures, hard to transfer pictures between devices, inconvenient layout. It's ridiculous to have the same photo in a folder, the main photo gallery, and whatever albums you put it into. It just makes the whole app super cluttered, so that whenever you want to find a picture in the main photo gallery you have to scroll past potentially thousands of pictures that you've already organized. The differentiation between a folder and an album is asinine.

author: A Google user
review: Just awesome! The automatic stories are great (the dates might be a little off if you are on a different time zone) the ability to find old photos by date, or people (as long as you tag them) and places (as long as your GPS indicator is turned on in your camera). And the ability to edit photos and share them with your friend for them to download, without having to create a bunch of emails is great!

author: A Google user
review: The new update makes the app unfortunately cumbersome to use. I liked having all of my pictures in one area, and being able to exclude libraries when necessary. Now, different folders are segregated and I have to go to library and find the photo folders I use most often. Cannot find a way to change this. Will be switching applications to something more usable and streamlined.

author: Shashi Kiran
review: Very poor options for a high quality photo app. 1. Photos in an album cannot be ordered bared in name of the photos 2. When you upload old photos they go into the photos based on time,date they are taken.need to scroll all the way to the last few years when the photo was taken even though it's upload now. 3. ability to upload a folder directly onto the album is missing. it's so irritating to select each photo into the album. 4. ordering multiple photos in an album at once fails most of the time.

author: A Google user
review: A very good way to manage ALL your photos from anywhere on any device. I tell my friends about it because its so delightful being able to browse my entire collection of photos on my phone. Its cool to skim through old photos and go back in time anywhere. Google photos is the solution to digital photo chaos. *edit. Deleting photos from the sd card - currently not working for me. *Edit. Suddenly not as useful as a gallery app when you cannot integrate it with other cloud storage options.

author: Justin Gandara
review: It was amazing, but I was kind of hoping for a cool idea, if we can use this app so we can watch our old videos offline, so that we don't have to wait for wifi or reception. In the edit part, they're should be a mirror adjustment so we can make our photos and videos backwards, and when there's a photo or video that's backwards, we flip flop it fowards. Also in fact, we love Google Photos when there's an unlimited storage, it's better than buying storage and wasting our money.

metadata.replyText: Hi Justin! Google Photos is a cloud storage and sharing service and requires an internet connection. You can view your photos offline after downloading: goo.gle/2LN2R1q. Also, feel free to share additional feedback here: http://goo.gle/3sPwq2I. Appreciate it!

author: Tanya P
review: It seems fairly handy. I don't totally understand how it works. I do know that all my fave photos from last 5 yrs are nicely displayed all the way down the scrolled page, nice & safe, they're not taking up space in my gallery. It has come in handy to find old photos that I thought I lost. Just don't start deleting, cause images will vanish from your gallery! Yikes! But handy lil 'Restore' option in Apps Trash saved the day. Haven't found much use for app features, overall great backup storage.

author: Tanya H.
review: Terrible! A whole bunch of my photos and videos are missing after this last update, or last few updates! Whole trips and memories are wiped out, I cannot find them at all! And not recent photos, but ones from last year, and years before. I go in to look at old photos and watch videos and nothing can be found. Maybe one photo, out of 20 or 30, is there, then everything else is gone. It's heartbreaking!

author: A Google user
review: Google Photos has been my go-to for everything we document in our lives. The program is very intuitive. It will convert your best memories into albums, animations, videos and more. The technology will even archive old photos or screenshots, with your permission of course! Program works with most third party websites to upload and order prints as well. Cant say enough!

author: A Google user
review: Keep getting pegged to rate this app so here goes... 1) Camera shortcut missing for last year 2) album sort is not permanent. No matter which sort you choose, it reverts back 3) after 4 years you still can't find/filter photos that aren't in any album yet But hey... at least you were able to monetize this by selling printed albums... before actually fixing any of the above issues that have been requested multiple times over the years.

author: Samantha Grobbel Manier
review: The facial recognition really bothers me now. It always thinks my cat May is my cat Mari & it's impossible to tell the app otherwise. I have to click EVERY PHOTO and manually change the name. Not to mention, google photos has to recognize a face in order to tag a photo of someone. If it doesn't detect the face you can't add a person or pet. (This happens VERY often.) It's rediculous and makes it so my search results for a person I want to look up are very incomplete. So many little issues.

author: Silas
review: The map! Best feature Edit: There's no way to turn off the zoom animation on memories. Please fix. also, give me the option to not use Gemini to search for photos. it does not do a good job

author: Melissa C.
review: This app will back up every picture on your sd card as soon as the picture/video is taken. But it will not delete them off card. You have to manually do it. If you have lost photos check the apps archive or trash folder. The app didn't lose them. You did. If it's slow to up load your photos than your phone provider sucks and or so does the wifi. Every setting is in the app settings. Take a tour of it first, before you start pointing. My only complaint is I can't title my movies anymore.

author: A Google user
review: I think it cool that I can look back on all my old pictures from years ago. It's really nostalgic to go down memory lane and but there is the issue of saving the pictures to whichever device your on. You guys have updated this application several times but fail to feature an option where you can select several photos and save them to your device. It's time consuming and unfair to have to go through photos one by one in order to save them. Please fix this issue

author: T N Loveridge
review: For what ever reason my phone decided to remove like 60% of my images, camera, downloads, screenshots etc. Off my local storage, I was loosing my kind as you can imagine until I found out Google photos has saved all of those deleted! Great! But I cannot find a single way to simply re sync or download all my photos back onto my phone without doing them one by one, but that resets the metadata on the images. This should be such a simple basic thing to have on it but it's not there.

author: e bonnet
review: The app is great but i dont like the constant notifications. I dont need any suggestions. Im not interested in posting or getting cards or going public. Stop notifications. I have to change my rating Google made me rely on them for my photos. If I knew I had to pay, I would have never saved years of photos in Google. Now I gotta deal with storage issues. I'm going backwards. Since June 1st, I have LOST PHOTOS! Bait and Switch! Google ????? I changed 4 to 2.

author: Evander Odoli
review: Google Photos is a game-changer! The app's AI-powered organization and search features make it ridiculously easy to find and relive my favorite memories. I love how it automatically backs up my photos and videos, so I never have to worry about losing them. The search function is incredibly intuitive, and I can even find specific people, places, or things in my photos. The sharing features are also super convenient. 🤩

author: Tanveer Ahmad
review: for a couple of weeks since the new update, some photos such as screenshots and downloads are not being uploaded onto Google photos despite all folders are selected to be uploaded. really disappointed as I can't find those photos in the Google photos. please get it sorted

metadata.replyText: Hi Tanveer. If your photos and videos don't sync to your Google Account, check your backup status. Learn how to troubleshoot issues with backup: https://goo.gle/3IzUW16.

author: Lisa Culhane
review: I love how Google Photos organizes photos not only by date, but by face (recognition), and how it offers logical suggestions that I usually accept. For instance, I receive suggestions for photos that I might want to rotate or archive. The editing features are straightforward which makes them easy to use. Overall, it helps me to easily organize and search for photos.

author: James Johnson
review: UPDATE AGAIN: I was happy to see old photos I had forgotten about. Being a Samsung user, I wish I could use this app as my default photo manager instead of the gallery. Being able to delete local photos when they are safe and sound on the cloud is nice. I still wish it was easier to download and self manage your library instead of going through the tedious task of downloading them one by one.

author: Jordan Latta
review: This app was worth it when it offered unlimited cloud storage by downsampling your photos, unless you wanted to pay more for storage so you can store full-quality images. Now, this app is almost worthless. I've been using the app for a few years now, so of course I've taken thousands of photos in that time and now it says my storage is full so i cant even create new albums to sort my old images, and the user interface is more concerned with convincing you to buy print photos than it is with actually keeping your stuff organized and easy to access. I have spent hours trying to weed out old photos i don't need in the cloud any more, which is painstaking when it won't let you select all photos in an album or system folder, so you have to hold your thumb on the screen for ten minutes straight as it slowly scrolls down to select all of your 500 best vacation images that you already spent time to sort into an album... and then once you did that, you would find out that there is no option to move those images into another system folder such as a "vacation" folder on an SD card that you can put into a computer or give to your grandma. Because heaven knows that my grandma doesn't know how to use a shared album. Yes, there are some good features. But they are overshadowed by the inconvenience of a bad UI that takes an engineer to locate simple settings, and a general lack of simple features. Google, look forward to a long list of feature requests in the near future on your "help and feedback" section.

author: Mohammod Abul Ahasan
review: Google Photo app's interface is very user-friendly. There is no fear of losing photos due to the automatic backup system. It is especially great how old photos come up as 'Memories'."

author: A Google user
review: The app does not work well.  I have a Pixel 2 smart phone which is supposed to automatically load my phone photos on to Google Cloud Photos.  Did fine for the first year, but now fails to load photos any more and  I can't find out why it doesn't work any more.  This app is still supposedly loaded, just not working!   Another complaint is picture quality.  Resolution is not as good as it should be and not as good as the phone camera is capable of taking..  I am guessing the app compresses photos to transmit them  loosing image quality. ?

author: Simone Davis
review: My photos I want to post on Marketplace are not available in in my "photos" app. I have to go find them in lala land, redownload individually so they are back on my phone. Ridiculous. It wasn't like this until some months ago and I tried to find a picture in my photos app.....nowhere to be found. Very tedious sometimes to get photos back on your actual phone for easy access.

metadata.replyText: Hi Simone! Try following the steps in this article to find your photos: goo.gle/362y6wg. If these didn't resolve your issues, can you please post your question in our Help Forum so product experts can work with you to resolve this issue: goo.gle/3o5JIVl?

author: A Google user
review: Organized yet not. Maybe to organized. There is an automatic album made for every way you save a photo. It's very organized but nothing is in the same spot. Quite difficult to find a photo you saved when later you don't know where you saved it from. An album or photo roll with all photos combined would be nice. Not getting rid of the album's made but maybe an additional one where they are all colocated.

author: Skye Bjorklund
review: I love how photos creates panoramic photos automatically! I have gotten some great shots, and the app is easy to navigate for those unfamiliar with a screen or working difficult photo editing apps. Photos is great at recommending old photos to look back on as memories. The only thing i don't like is there's a lot of menus to click through in order to access albums.

author: Tara Brookover
review: Can't find the collages, stylized photos, animations, etc...even when I get a notification that Google created something like this for me automatically, I click that notification & it takes me to the app not the creation. I look everywhere but can never find what I'm looking for. Seems like the only thing I can find is the highlight reels from previous years 🤔 seems like the 1st version I had was way better than any updates I've downloaded! This app should be top notch! Hey Google get with it!

metadata.replyText: Hi Tara! We're sorry to hear you're having trouble. We suggest that you take a look at this article: goo.gle/37eSSXM to fix problems with the app. If the problem persists, we ask that you post a topic in the Google Photos Help Forum to get help from our experts: goo.gle/3o5JIVl. We hope we helped.

author: hana qalesya
review: Gallery is an essential app for storing and organizing photos and videos. It allows me to keep my memories safe and easily accessible anytime. The app is simple to use, with features like albums, search options, and editing tools. I like how everything is arranged neatly, making it easy to find specific pictures. Overall, Gallery is practical and important

author: A Google user
review: Love this app! I make sure to hook up my phone whenever I get a new one. It has saved so many great memories when my old phones have died suddenly and I haven't been able to get them off of the old phone. Plus if I want to put an old photo back on my phone for whatever reason I can. All it makes great suggestions for animations and other things. LOVE it!

author: Steven Ercolani

author: susan Lynn

author: Norman Nuthu
review: Google Photos is an absolute game-changer! It effortlessly organizes my entire photo library, freeing up precious storage space on my device. The AI-powered search feature is mind-blowing, allowing me to find specific photos with just a few keywords. Plus, the auto-generated collages and animations add a fun touch to my memories. Thank you, Google, for this incredible app! 📸🌟

author: Natalie Doran
review: The search function has gone badly downhill. Keyword searches are just as likely to include wildly-off-the-mark images as they are to exclude the photos you're specifically looking for. If the images do show up, they appear only in the Best Match section, with no way to sort by date. ETA: thanks for the reply, but I am already on the latest release. I've also submitted feedback in the app with screenshots.

metadata.replyText: Hi Natalie. We’ve heard your feedback and have updated Search. Please update the app to the latest version. If you’re still having issues, please send in-app feedback adding “#search”: https://goo.gle/4ewu28p.

author: A Google user
review: It's ok. So far it's been fairly easy to manage so can't complain.

author: A Google user

author: Kristin Kullmann

I wish there were a warning when saving or backing up at low quality

author: Ry Ry
review: Could be better, especially the search option. I need it to be able to be specific to certain words typed to find a picture. HOWEVER, Google Photos has been a lifesaver to me today, because for some reason my photos from late October 23 to early Jan 24 are missing, and unfortunately my old phone died the "black screen of death", so there's no way for me to use Samsung Switch to transfer them, but thankfully Photos automatically backs up my precious memories and I'm able to retrieve them!!

author: Bethany Abbott
review: If you are even reading the reviews, you are wasting time. Do you take a lot of photos? Here's an app that will change your life for the better. I have so many albums on here, I can find a photo from 5 years ago in 5 seconds. It might take a bit of time to back up all of your photos, but you'll never lose them again. Back up time has also significantly decreased. It's so easy and convenient. Do yourself the favor and download.

author: Odunlami Rasheed

author: Nathaniel Pitts

New annoyance: I can no longer favorite photos from Memories, which takes a TON of the value of Memories for me. From 4 stars to 2 stars. Update: I figured it out, you have to tap and hold a memory to favorite it now. A heads up would have been nice. Bumped back to 4 stars.

author: Rachael Page
review: This app was amazing, and then they recently changed it and it no longer is intuitive. Getting rid of the Assistant tab was a huge mistake. Now I can't find my shared albums or the auto-generated collages and stuff. I don't know why everything always has to be messed with, when it already works. Fixing things until they're broken, all in the name of newness, is the new norm, and it's frustrating.

author: Emad Steitieh
review: I love this app. It saved my important photos I took with the many phones I lost, damaged or failed something in them. I thought I lost these photos forever. Suddenly Google Photos comes back to me with old photos for my children and family, important occasions and friends. Awesome, Awesome, Awesome. The 5 star is the least. It was lovely to see my children when they were too young. Thank you Google.

author: A Google user

I needed to find a photo of my truck, so I searched 'truck' and the app provided me with all the photos I had of my truck.

author: A Google user
review: Very good app for storing pictures and videos. It is also a great help during travels where you and your friends can create a shared album and just share all your pictures together so you can post real time if you want. Plus upon downloading the app, I found old photos here because I didn't know I still have back up of pictures I had from my previous phones. It also has that feature that creates stylized edit on your pictures and creates animations for consecutive shots. Overall, great app!

It's pretty universally compatible, I use it across phones, tablets, and laptops with no issues what do ever. I highly recommend Google photos.

metadata.replyText: Hi Mkrtchyan. When you create an album on Google Photos, a copy of the file is created, but it will not consume storage. If you delete the photo from the album, it will remain in your Google Photos account. If the photo is deleted, it will be deleted everywhere. Also, take a look at this article: goo.gle/37eSSXM to fix problem with the app. Thanks.

author: A Google user

Now I can't find a pic with ease to save my life. I'm missing pictures. ( Which makes me sooo upset). And I have to wait for a pic to download just to send one! I can't just go to it and send it... author: A Google user
review: I've been using Google photos for 4.5 years and it has never let me down. The photos stay organized, you can edit them with enhanced features, and there is so much storage. I love that I can find my photos in my drive and the photos app. I use everything Google, so I highly recommend using this.

author: A Google user
review: Convoluted, been backing up 500 photos for hours and can't find them in my Google drive, anywhere. 500 photos, been going for 3+hours... If you want to waste time, get this app, hell your Android phone already has it, and you can't delete it! Guess it's time to jailbreak my phone and make it work how I want it to, not how you want it to.

author: A Google user
review: Absolutely horrible for our business. THERES NO DATE WHEN SCROLLING THROUGH PHOTOS. We take dozens sometimes a hundred photos every day for record keeping and have a shared album to store them for all of us. Its a total pain in the ass to find a picture because theres NO DATE on the side when scrolling! you have to open every photo to see where you are, then you have to start back at the top or click through every picture! Absolutely horrible. Google made no effort in shared albums.

author: Speed Z
review: Photos app for a back up is terrible. You cannot find anything that's backed up there. It doesn't organize photos based on the same albums you have them organized in your phone. It just piles them all in one place by date so you have to scroll for days to find anything. Back up should mirror the way it's organized into albums on the device.

metadata.replyText: Hi there. You can back up specific device folders. Learn more: https://goo.gle/3PhHnqU. Also, feel free to share feedback with us here: https://goo.gle/3gaHLEz.

author: Divinitiy Tjuhutiy
review: Hate this app now! Doing too much and, no longer user friendly. Used to always make collages before these new updates. Now collage sets pics in no logical order, and chops off photos. Ugh! Movies and slides need speed options. Also, can't find anything anymore. If you place items like Utilities in no logical order, at least put in a search option to help us find stuff.

author: A Google user
review: Best photo app out there, unlimited storage with decent quality (it would be perfect if they increased the video quality to 4k60, but that's fine tho). Assistant does a great job creating short movies, collages, etc. Albuns organized by people via face detection is great when you wanna search for a photo of someone specifically. Couldn't recommend more.

author: A Google user
review: Never been so suprised...! And just so happy...! All at the same time!!! I've just recovered hundreds of photos I had backed up using a phone that I later lost in December last year!!! I've now decided to scan all my old photos that are safely kept in the family albums, and back them up in the google photos' free 15GB cloud drive. I LOVE THIS APP! Strongly recommend it to one&all. Thanks Google.

author: ARYSS BRUCE-GALLASHAW
review: I love using google photos a lot. I can make new albums for my photos, save old photos that I thought I never had and some much more. My only problem is that recently I haven't been able to share my photos with anyone recently and it really annoys me because all of my good pictures are in there and if I want to show someone something I can't. It sucks but other than that the app is wonderful.I just hope that they fix it so that I am able to share photos again.

metadata.replyText: Hi there! Have a look at this article: goo.gle/37eSSXM to fix problems with the app. Also, we suggest that you take a look at this article: goo.gle/372Mmmh to know how to share photos and videos with your contacts. If that won't fix the issue you can ask our experts on the Help forum: goo.gle/3o5JIVl. Hope that helps.

author: Kate Brownstone
review: Was great until this year. The automatically generated collages and memory related stuff was the best part. I say was because it was updated this year (2020) and they aren't organized like they used to be. I can't find them after the push notification and neither can my physicist and tech-savvy husband find them. Google keeps destroying their own great products. It is like they want us to stop using it, it has become that bad. The automatically generated content is now un-usable.

author: Jeremy Moore
review: It stores your photos just fine. Some decent organization as well. Automatic face identification is nice, when it works. If there is a way to select pictures to direct it to identify faces, I have no idea how. That's the biggest issue with this app. So many widgets and suggestions but absolutely no explanation on what it actually does. I can archive photos, but I have no idea where they go or how to get them back. The special stuff only seems to unlock when it wants but then you can't find it...

author: A Google user
review: Tried creating an album this morning on my phone. However most photos did not show up in the album when I opened Google photos in my computer. Now Google photos is telling me that album is deleted. I feel like there is a "sync" button I need to press but can't find it. It also sucks that if someone shares an album with me I have to download each photo to my phone to add photos to my album. Not intuitive to use

author: christina shipley
review: I hate it. I now can't find any of my old photos, nor edit immeadiatly. It shorted my data count and its more difficult to maneuver. Used to I could make fantastic storybooks & collages all in one spot immeadiatly, this is all scattered and stupid. Can't stand the new update!! Too many ads. I dont shop online so all the pop-ups are annoying & get in the way of my research:(

author: Nancy Broady
review: This is the worst experience that I have had in years. I CAN'T FIND my photos! Why in the world can't you make this a straight forward thing. I have no control over my own files & pictures. These devices are hooked to Google. Does Google have a stake in every company that makes phones and tablets? When the app takes and stores my photos, they should be stored in a folder that says "Photos" so I can just click on it. I shouldn't click on 1/2 dozen things to get to my photos! Change it!

author: Katie Fox
review: The latest update is not an upgrade. The memories are a rip off of some other apps but I cannot watch it all again or go back through the photos. Once I close out of the memories, I can't find it again within the app. The automatically created collages, videos, color pops, ect... Are not nearly as good as they used be and are almost all garbage that I never save, whereas I used to save those wonderful creations all the time. Looking forward to a better update soon, I hope.

author: Matt
review: Great interface, got the hang of it fast. Reliable with photo backup and saving. Recently I made a screen recording, not using the camera app. Usually my screen recordings are automatically put in the screenshots album, but I couldn't find it. I looked everywhere I could think of but couldn't find it. Despite making me able to send the recording to other people. Maybe create a screen recording album? Also being a reliable app, you can easily edit photos easily since it's easy to navigate.

author: Donald Smith
review: it is not as flexible as my old iPhone. some photos and videos I have to save to clipboard and then can't find them. sometimes I want to post from my albums, but only the gallery is available. moving pictures or videos from albums is problematic. I have tried at least 6 times to download the update and it will not download. Just get the circling.

author: Yves R
review: Google photo helps to upload to cloud on its own and helps clear up photo space on my phone which helps alot when I realized I have no more space while traveling. It is very handy when you take a lot of photos and videos with your phone. It also has memories features on the top of the page when you open the app, and it will show you old photos from each year, and of a variety of stuffs such as vacation or food etc. it's very good as it makes me look back and see the good memories.

author: Rahul Ghotkule
review: from new update photo editor is lagging and to slow observed many software glitch Great app but after the recent updates, whenever I edit my photos the app keeps crashing. I hope you fix that issue and add more useful features. Maybe you can add a much better portrait photo option than whatever we have now. Note: Hey guys, after the recent update I couldn't find an option to reduce my pictures (Portrait blur) amount. So, put your magic there too.

metadata.replyText: Hi Rahul. We're sorry if you ran into trouble. Learn more: goo.gle/37eSSXM. Also, feel free to share feedback with us here: https://goo.gle/3gaHLEz.

author: A Google user
review: Keeps all my photos organized and I love theres a search bar. I've gotten a new phone a couple times in the past few years and all my old pictures and new pictures I take are there! Also it will occasionally take pictures and put them into a fun collage or animate them or use a stylizing tool that makes the original picture super vibrate and gorgeous while keeping the original photo!

author: Samantha
review: Unreasonable sometimes. Very limited editor. Pop up suggestions won't get out of the way when editing. Can't scrub through video with suggestions like "Export Top Shots" in front of timeline. No X to send it away. Can't find an option to edit video speed. My old Samsung's built in camera editor was better. Only reviewing because I'm at the end of my rope. Want to throw the Pixel 6 out a window.

author: Yasin Emir AKBAŞ
review: I've been using Google photos for years now, I like everything about it except when you sync the photos with cloud and delete from the device, the reference photos disappears from folders, and you have to scroll all the way down to find if you are looking for old photos/videos. I hope they fix it and uploaded photos also stays in the folder to find photos easier rather than scrolling hundred times.

metadata.replyText: Hi Yasin. We value your feedback. Please share your thoughts with us here: goo.gle/3sPwq2I. Thanks!

author: A Google user
review: safety is a the best way to get ahold of your old photos from the times you had a good time or even them not to good times 🤔 You have a opportunity to get photos from your college or even if you want to build a photo book of awesome and beautiful pictures, just to look at for them times when your day just not going well for you .Yes,it may cost you a little bit but wants the price you can put to a smile on your face.I can almost guarantee you will not regret to build you a book.

author: A Google user
review: On my tablet Google Photos is great, has all my photos in it,.  When I first turned on my laptop and Google Photos was there, it showed all the photos, and under Albums it listed all my albums from my tablet, that I had created.  Photos all there.  First day.     But after that they no longer all show.   Now some are missing from my laptop and under Albums none of my created Albums from tablet app show, are not there. None of my own divided up categories that showed the first day.   I am missing crucial photos.  It is not good enough, when you cannot trust the app to transfer everything into other devicesl!   I have to still send the crucial missing photos to myself and download into laptop,to save on an external drive to make sure I don't lose them if my tablet ever crashes!  How good is this?

author: Arthur Dgn
review: 1. Not all photos are backing up from phone - some are missing when viewing from web client. When adding to album, the missing photos are shown in album on phone, but not on web, and the count is wrong. Photos were taken using default camera on pixel 2. Makes me completely lose trust with using this to organise photos. 2. "Recent highlights" is an awefull feature with no way to disable it. I know what my recent photos are. Why does this useless stupidity take half my screen every time?

author: Kelly Reardon
review: Not loving the new update. The app was great before they changed everything with no warning. I own a pet sitting business, and I'm always taking photos and screenshots and sending them to my clients throughout the day. This new update has made my job so much more difficult, I can't find anything anymore! I'm going to give this app another week to see if they either change it back or I can get used to it, otherwise I've got to switch to something else.

metadata.replyText: We’re sorry to hear that, Kelly. We value your feedback. Feel free to share feedback with us here: https://goo.gle/3gaHLEz.

author: Sarah Youssef
review: Always got precious memories saved so even if you lose your phone, change it, etc your photos and videos are still safely saved. Super easy to use, you can even make your own home video from a collage of photos and videos in your library. You can even organize photos based on a specific person's face, making it easier to find specific photos. Sharing and sending photos and videos is pretty easy as well.

author: Helena Adetutu Falade
review: This app is so underrated. It is the best record keeper i have ever seen. No unnecessary ads and its back up is really amazing. Makes it easy to search for photos and videos even when you don't remember the actual date or month, you can just search based on year. While you search per year, it stills lays it out per months on each year. In a nut shell, it's super awesome.

author: bedriye keçeci
review: I can't find some of my photos. I look everywhere and I find them in the bin even though I'm definitely sure I hadn't deleted them. I'm trying to send a video but then again i can watch it on gallery but the video isn't actually there to send??? I have to restore it somehow. Photographs are saved memories and this app puts them in danger. If I had the chance to switch this app with something I wouldn't stop for a minute. It's that bad.

author: Thomas Robillard
review: July 2020: the update says it is simpler and easier to "find your memories" but now I can't find groups like my videos and people. Horrible update. Old: It doesn't appear to separate downloaded photos from camera photos. The "camera" album contains both download photos and shots from my camera. Unless there is a way to fix this, I don't really care for the photo app. If Google comments and informs me that there is a way to correct this, I will update my review.

author: sudheer kumar
review: While saving photos on Google is a good option. We don't have the option to download or delete all Google photos at a time to a device. Please update this. And moreover if we have a photo on phone and that was backed up to google, we don't need to be reminded to free up space in device. I just clicked the "free up space" option and lost all my photos from device. Even though they're backed up to google, I can't find pictures from my device so that i can upload directly to a website or some apps.

author: A Google user
review: there are so many things I love about this app. It makes it easier to access old photos I no longer have on my phone. It also provides frequent reminders of happy past moments , create collages and edits photos with a nice touch. But my favorite part about it, is the fact it recognizes faces and groups the pictures of each individual together. You can even name the face and the next time you type their name in search bar, you will get all of the pictures they appear in. Simply brilliant!!

author: Anirban Banik
review: This is an wonderful app without any second thought. But the recent update is bothering me cause I can't find photos automatic creation of stylised, animation, collage from the backed up pictures. Previously it was easy but now it seems there is no tab for that. Its all coming random on the recent highlights. Please solve it.

author: natural magic
review: LOVE THIS APP. I have literally thousands of photographs (seriously, over 30,000) in this app. Google Photos happily takes care of one of the most precious things you have -- your memories. I recommend taking photos of your most precious photographs, backside too if there's writing on it. If there is a fire or some other catastrophe (heaven forbid!), you don't have to run around frantically looking for a photo album before running out the door. Think about that!

author: A Google user
review: Love this app. One feature that is a serious drawback is that if you delete a photo from Google photos, it deletes it from your device as well and vice versa. I understand the idea of backup and sync but to not have the option on a photo to photo basis seems ludicrous to me! When I've wanted to clean up my phone and open up some memory locally, I have actually lost photos not remembering this bizarre feature. That a backup is no longer backed up but rather deleted. Come on Google!

author: Arjay Delacruz
review: The app is amazing it lead me to photo and memories i never no i had, and it was a best experience going through old photos. Amazing Thanks 👍

author: Rebecca
review: Junk! It come with the phone, the only photo gallery and it's junk. All kinds of unuseful things, constant updates, can't find what I'm looking for when I do look, no way to control the manager unless you shut it down. I didn't need another social app and that should be optional by choice to get the app. But like I said it came with the phone, so I'm stuck with it or my phone& other apps won't function properly. Rather put no star rating...

author: A Google user
review: I used to love this app. I could count on it to save all my photos and it gave me comfort knowing if something unexpected ever happened to my phone, I could always find my pictures again. But I upgraded to a new phone recently, and now this app is not working. It gets stuck when backing up my photos. It'll show me it has 44 photos to back up, and hours later, I go back to the app and it will still show the same 44 photos backing up. I'm very disappointed with this and I hope it gets fixed soon.

author: Elbert Jones Jr
review: I don't know how but it's good to see some of my old photos from my old phone that maybe saved up in the cloud appear on my Google photos. I have no quite a few albums at a good price. I just wish that they can add a feature to LinkedIn videos that's been taken. And although I got the six before the seven came out by the way the little longer I would have to seven with her the photos are immaculately beautiful.

author: Sandra Williams
review: Sharing - Super easy and quick sharing between iOS (Apple) and Android users by clicking a link - NO "must have account or app" nonsense. You can have a shared album that both users can add to as long as they have a Google account. Sorting - The layout is very comprehensive and makes massive amounts of photos easy to navigate and enjoy. Search - I almost never have to scroll through all my photos; I can almost always find my photo by searching place, time, people, objects, date, colors, etc.

author: Rick T
review: Simply the best. I don't 500 characters are enough to say about this app so I'll make it short. Not only easy great for organizing my photos and easy to share, it fixes my photos, automatically creates panorama pictures from individual pictures I took, automatically creates collage from related photos. The feature I like the most is it often shows me old pictures so I can relive the moment.

author: Travis Be
review: I really liked this app, but I am taking stars away because I can't find the Google created creations from my photos. The animations and Then/now comparisons are so cool but I can only find them from the notification, never in the app. Sometimes I get two notifications and only get to see one creation and that makes me sad.

author: Sim Dhaliwal
review: Suggest that there should be an option to export all photos to phone w/o messing the timeline. Used sync before but never experienced all my photos being deleted from the device; accidentally pressed free up space. Had 3k photos now only have 200+ left. Sync was on, good that my photos were backed. However hate that I have to download them in device, once downloaded, they don't go by their "date taken" anymore. old photos are now below my gallery i have to scroll further to find recent photos.

author: Cole Sleaver
review: Can't find any way to reverse/flip an image. Looked it up and apparently, as a result over four years ago, this is apparently not a feature on this photo app. Like, really? You can rotate a photo with no problem, but when it comes to flipping/inverting a photo, it's apparently the lost language of atlantis, so now I decided to remove one more star from my initial review while writing this. Made by google facebook page still hasn't read my messages, minus one more star

author: Ranae Jones
review: Ugh 🤬...why did y'all change the layout once again?! I DO NOT LIKE IT! Especially how "people and pets" is the top folder. I don't use that as a way to sort or search for photos. We should be able to delete that or at least move it to the bottom. Also, I didn't ask nor did I want you to sort my "documents" into folders. I had my photos the way I wanted them... Stay out of my business! I hate how y'all move stuff around for no reason 😒🙄

metadata.replyText: Hi Ranae. We value your feedback. Please share your thoughts with us here: goo.gle/3sPwq2I. Thanks.

author: Ace
review: don't get me wrong, i love the app. however there are a few confusing things. may i request that it can be the same as a standard gallery where you can find default albums of everything you have uploaded? it's kind of difficult to go around the app and you can't seem to move a picture from one folder to another without it being duplicated. i can't find a specific photo so i would have to scroll down everytime. hope you fix this.

author: Parul Yadav
review: very amazing photos that help to find my old photos

author: ADV Parth Sarthy
review: It's a real great app, simply the best.. but there should be an option to add faces when the app can't recognise them in the photos, this is a major issue I've faced, and that when I search for,say screen records, or downloads, or WhatsApp photos, videos, at times it so happens that it's there, uploaded, but it doesn't show in the search results.

author: Grant N
review: App needs to take away features or something. It is very complicated to find where images are located. Some images save to messages, some to Snapchat, some to insta folders with almost no rhyme or reason. With that, it is very difficult to integrate photos with any other app because they can't dig into all of these random folders and locations on your phone so you can't find the picture you want to post on Instagram for example. Get rid of the printing and the collages like what...

metadata.replyText: We value your feedback, Grant. Feel free to share feedback with us here: https://goo.gle/3gaHLEz.

author: A Google user
review: The app good at its basic features, but it is way too annoying when it comes to sharing albums to anyone....even though the invitation is sent but the receiver does not get any invite to check out the album!!!!.....moreover the app is bad at adding partner accounts..... Even if I select my partner it says "could not find this Google account"!!!!???..... Please fix this soon......

author: Evans Burgess
review: New update is a game ruiner. The most useful edit feature was the keystone/perspective cropping tool. I used it regularly when taking a photo of a document or an old photo. That feature is totally gone! Instead there is an AI auto frame that actually adds made-up pseudo - letters/words. It also now replaces the original in the Photos stream, whereas it was a choice. It's like Google thinks we're babies and thinks it knows what is good for us.

metadata.replyText: Hi Evans. Thanks for reaching out. We're working on a fix. Stay tuned for updates.

author: Outi Ilona
review: Edit-no I can not use Ask Photos because the requirements are absurd. Deleting the app./ Previously I could search for a photo with keywords and after finding it I could opt to go the day when the photo had been taken. Now, apparently, you have taken this option away entirely, and by so taken away the function I used most. And the photo editing options are devastatingly bad! It was a good run but apparently ai first means users last. I'm moving back to film just to get rid of all this.

author: Jill Waller
review: Update: I really loath the new Save as Copy as the only option after editing photos. Just save the edited photo to my default location - don't make me hunt for it! After losing my old photo editor on my previous phone, I have finally come to appreciate Google Photos. I can crop, edit, and apply filters all in the same app. Very useful.

author: Andrew Afegbai
review: I REALLY FEEL GREAT TO VIEW MY OLD PHOTO AGAIN. MY MEMORY IS ONCE AGAIN REFRESH. THANK YOU

author: Janice Booth Tuten
review: My photos have been rearranged and now I can't find one when I want it...never wanted them changed. I knew when I took them in a time sequence, now just scattered...mixed up. Sometimes many duplicated...taking up space, causing me not to be able to take important shots ...😱😨😭

author: Louis Waterstreet

author: A Google user
review: All these new ideas and ways of looking at my pictures are great but...... Why can't I also see my picture albums the way I have them saved and sorted by albums that I have named them. Another great feature would be if I could tell the app to not show certain folders that I don't want to show.... like the folder with my music. All my album covers show and I have to scan thru hundreds of album covers when looking for a picture. It's maddening. I used to have an app named JustPictures that did let you block any folder you wanted but it seems to have just disappeared.

author: Torie Karlas Lane Sr.
review: I love how it makes videos from all the old pictures I had forgotten about and helps me find pictures of people

author: Danny Robinson
review: I have used Google for quite a long time, and then discovered photos over decade ago. Marking cloud services as suspicious until proven otherwise Ive found google more reliable than drives, and now my whole collection is accessable which means I use and show off photos more. Since then I have enjoyed its suggestions, rotations, collages, slideshow movies. My camera gets more use and shots are easy to find by time, people, cats, dogs, location, colour, theme or object. private search for photos

author: Max Höfer
review: Looked promising at first but turned out to be one of the worst apps I have ever used. Syncing didn't work properly. It also lacks some of the most basic functionality (or hides ir so well that you can't find it within 90 minutes of searching - I don't know). All I wanted is to delete pictures out of the cloud but NOT from devices. Never got this to work...

author: J T (Exanime)
review: Terrible app. Finding old photos is basically impossible, search feature never returns a thing useful and if it gets close you can't do anything to help yourself (like jumping from a close result to the rest of the photos taken that day). "Select all"? author: Peter Kut
review: This app was phenomenal for years! The latest update has taken away one of the editing features that I used constantly! metadata.replyText: Sorry to hear that, Peter. We're working on a fix. Stay tuned for updates.

author: ariadna echeverria
review: I fear i may have lost a big amount of my photos somehow. I deleted photos on my device after they were backed up on this app but didn't delete all of them, thankfully, and have noticed a bunch of the photos on my device are not saved on the app. I have also been searching for specific photos that are no longer on my device and can't find them at all on the app. This was a big fear of mine, to lose precious memories, and I thought this was going to be the safest way to ensure never losing them.

author: Matt Montero
review: The new video controls are terrible. They consume the entire screen, almost, and the play button is stuck over in the corner like a forgotten element, instead of the most important thing. Maybe it's because I've scaled up text, but even then, there's no excuse for such an awful change from the old video controls, which worked fine at my settings. Go back and fix it, Google.

metadata.replyText: Sorry to hear that, Matt. We value your feedback. Feel free to share feedback with us here: https://goo.gle/3gaHLEz.

author: Diganta Majumder
review: Yesterday I was uploading some of my old photos because the unlimited storage will end on June thia year. I saw two major issues. 1. The photos are not properly arranged as their date and time. A photo from 2018 is showing in place of 2011. 2016 photos are being shown in 2017 tab. But after opening the details of the photos, they show right date. 2. At the end of the photo list, there are some empty squares which seems like corrupted image data. Please fix it. I don't want to lose any pic.

author: FI Hunter
review: Love Google Photos! Handy for finding photos quickly. Great storage, photo sharing and easy access. Xx July 2020 Not liking the recept update /layout. Used to love all the wee animations, colour pops etc created now cannot find them anywhere. Find it harder to find shared albums and hate having the search bar down the bottom. Also don't like how your recent moment or flashbacks flip through at the top and don't stay still then your onto something different! For this change I've removed a star.

author: Lauren Burkeen
review: I loved the app before. Now when it makes a suggestion, I don't have enough time to look at it and decide to save it before it moves on to the next picture and disappears forever. I used to be able to look at Google Photos suggested collages or animations, now it is organized where I can't find anything except my own photos and my own creations.

author: Snow White Dopey Disney

author: Rose B.

author: A Google user

Other than that it's a great app. Highly recommended.

author: Eternal Void

author: Jacob Hahn
review: Creating an album on your phone automatically syncs all content to the cloud, even with backup and sync turned off. It does this with no warning and absolutely no way to stop the process once it has started. I'm now sitting here watching my phone upload hundreds of photos and gigabytes of video without my consent, taking up all my bandwidth and absolutely draining my battery. Deleting the album off the phone doesn't stop the process, and turning off data, wi-fi, or the phone only delays it until they are turned back on. Plus Google has helpfully decided to place a banner of ads for their paid printing service right at the top of the library tab, instead of hiding it away in an options menu where it belongs. The average user would, 99.99% of the time, be going to the library tab to find a photo or set of photos to view at the moment, not pay $10 to have a photobook of the pictures printed and mailed to them the next week, so why is it the first thing you see in your library?
